practice_templates.title: Permission digits drill
practice_templates.action: Create 5 files and set their modes from a table (644, 600, 755, 750, 700) with chmod. Check each with ls -l and write down what the owner, group and others digits allow.
practice_templates.success_check: Explain every digit of 755 and 640 without notes.
practice_templates.resource_hint: man chmod; search: linux file permissions octal

practice_templates.title: Process control lab
practice_templates.action: Start a long-running command such as sleep 300 in the background. Find it with ps and pgrep, stop it with kill (SIGTERM), then move a second job between foreground and background with jobs, fg and bg.
practice_templates.success_check: Show the PID of a running process and stop it without using kill -9.
practice_templates.resource_hint: man ps; man kill; search: linux process states and signals

practice_templates.title: Filesystem tour
practice_templates.action: Use cd, pwd, ls -la and find to visit /etc, /var/log and your home directory. Create a nested path with mkdir -p and locate a file by name with find.
practice_templates.success_check: Reach the same directory using both an absolute and a relative path.
practice_templates.resource_hint: man find; search: linux filesystem hierarchy standard

practice_templates.title: Quoting experiments
practice_templates.action: Write a script that stores a value containing spaces in a variable and prints it unquoted, in double quotes and in single quotes. Add command substitution with $(...) and a default value with ${var:-default}.
practice_templates.success_check: Predict the output of each quoting variant before running it.
practice_templates.resource_hint: bash manual: quoting; search: bash quoting rules

practice_templates.title: Loop and test script
practice_templates.action: Write a script that loops over the entries of a directory with for, labels each as a file or directory using [[ -f ]] and [[ -d ]] inside if/elif/else, and uses a while read loop to process a text file line by line.
practice_templates.success_check: The script runs correctly on an empty directory and on filenames that contain spaces.
practice_templates.resource_hint: search: bash if for while examples

practice_templates.title: Log slicing practice
practice_templates.action: Take a sample log file. Use grep to filter lines, sed to replace a pattern and awk to print and total one column. Chain them with pipes to answer three questions about the log.
practice_templates.success_check: Explain what each command in your pipeline contributes.
practice_templates.resource_hint: man grep; search: awk print column sum

practice_templates.title: Folder organiser script
practice_templates.action: Write a Python script using pathlib that lists a directory, creates a subfolder for each file extension and moves the files into them.
practice_templates.success_check: Run it twice on the same folder with no errors and no duplicate moves.
practice_templates.resource_hint: python docs: pathlib; search: python shutil move

practice_templates.title: Command runner
practice_templates.action: Use subprocess.run with a list of arguments to run git --version, capture stdout and the return code, and print a clear message when the return code is not zero. Add a main guard and one argparse option.
practice_templates.success_check: Explain why the command is passed as a list instead of a shell string.
practice_templates.resource_hint: python docs: subprocess.run; search: python argparse basics

practice_templates.title: Failure-proof script
practice_templates.action: Write a script that reads a config file. Use try/except/else/finally to handle a missing file and invalid content separately, log each error and exit with a non-zero status.
practice_templates.success_check: Trigger each error path on purpose and show the matching message.
practice_templates.resource_hint: python docs: errors and exceptions; search: python custom exceptions

practice_templates.title: Branch and merge lab
practice_templates.action: In a scratch repository, create a feature branch, commit on it and on main, merge it, then create and resolve a deliberate merge conflict.
practice_templates.success_check: Explain fast-forward versus merge-commit using git log --graph --oneline on your repo.
practice_templates.resource_hint: git docs: git-branch, git-merge; search: git merge conflict resolve

practice_templates.title: Clean commit practice
practice_templates.action: Change three files, stage only two of them, commit with a clear message and then amend that message. Run git status and git diff --staged before and after each step.
practice_templates.success_check: Show what is staged, unstaged and committed at each step using git status.
practice_templates.resource_hint: git docs: git-add, git-commit; search: git staging area explained

practice_templates.title: Remote round trip
practice_templates.action: Create a bare repository locally, add it as a remote, push a branch, clone it into a second folder, change a file there and push. Back in the first copy, git fetch then git pull, and fix a rejected push on purpose.
practice_templates.success_check: Explain the difference between git fetch and git pull.
practice_templates.resource_hint: git docs: git-remote, git-push; search: git fetch vs pull

practice_templates.title: Closure counter lab
practice_templates.action: Write a makeCounter() function that returns increment and reset functions sharing a private count. Then reproduce the var-in-a-loop setTimeout bug and fix it two ways (let, and an IIFE).
practice_templates.success_check: Explain why each callback saw the same value and how your fix changes that.
practice_templates.resource_hint: MDN: closures; search: javascript var vs let loop closure

practice_templates.title: Promise ordering experiments
practice_templates.action: Write a script with console.log, setTimeout, a resolved Promise and an async function. Predict the output order on paper first, then run it and correct your prediction.
practice_templates.success_check: Predict the output of a new 5-line mix of timers and promises correctly.
practice_templates.resource_hint: search: javascript event loop microtask macrotask

practice_templates.title: Array method workout
practice_templates.action: Given an array of 10 order objects, use map, filter and reduce to compute total revenue, the list of paid order ids, and revenue per customer. No for-loops.
practice_templates.success_check: Say which method returns a new array and which mutates, for 6 common methods.
practice_templates.resource_hint: MDN: Array methods

practice_templates.title: Semantic page rebuild
practice_templates.action: Take a page built only from divs and rebuild it with header, nav, main, section, article, footer and a real button. Run a keyboard-only pass (Tab, Enter) through it.
practice_templates.success_check: Name the landmark role of each element you used and show it works with only a keyboard.
practice_templates.resource_hint: MDN: HTML elements reference; search: html semantic elements accessibility

practice_templates.title: Layout drills
practice_templates.action: Recreate a navbar, a centred card and a 3-column responsive card grid, first with flexbox then with CSS grid.
practice_templates.success_check: Explain main axis versus cross axis and when you would choose grid over flex.
practice_templates.resource_hint: search: css flexbox froggy; css grid garden

practice_templates.title: Mobile-first breakpoints
practice_templates.action: Style a page for 360px width first, then add a min-width media query at 768px that changes the layout. Test with the browser device toolbar.
practice_templates.success_check: Show the page working at 360px and 1024px and explain what the viewport meta tag does.
practice_templates.resource_hint: MDN: responsive design; media queries

practice_templates.title: Event loop blocking demo
practice_templates.action: Write an HTTP server with one route that runs a 3-second synchronous loop and one fast route. Show the fast route stalls, then move the heavy work to a worker thread or split it up.
practice_templates.success_check: Explain why the fast route stalled and what fixed it.
practice_templates.resource_hint: search: node.js event loop phases; worker_threads

practice_templates.title: Package.json tour
practice_templates.action: Create a project with npm init, install one dependency and one devDependency, add a start and a test script, and split code into two CommonJS or ES modules.
practice_templates.success_check: Explain what each field in your package.json does and why lockfiles matter.
practice_templates.resource_hint: npm docs: package.json; search: commonjs vs es modules

practice_templates.title: Stream a large file
practice_templates.action: Generate a 200MB text file. Count its lines once with readFileSync and once with createReadStream. Compare memory use with process.memoryUsage().
practice_templates.success_check: Explain why the stream version uses less memory.
practice_templates.resource_hint: Node docs: stream and fs

practice_templates.title: Shape hierarchy
practice_templates.action: Model Shape, Circle and Rectangle with an overridden area() method. Store them in a List<Shape> and print each area through the base type.
practice_templates.success_check: Explain which area() runs and why (dynamic dispatch).
practice_templates.resource_hint: Java tutorial: inheritance, polymorphism

practice_templates.title: Interface or abstract class?
practice_templates.action: Design a Payment feature two ways: an interface with CardPayment and UpiPayment, and an abstract class that shares validation code. Write down when each fits.
practice_templates.success_check: Give two concrete reasons to pick an abstract class and two to pick an interface.
practice_templates.resource_hint: search: java abstract class vs interface

practice_templates.title: Checked vs unchecked drill
practice_templates.action: Write a method that reads a file (checked IOException) and parses a number (unchecked NumberFormatException). Handle each properly, add try-with-resources and a custom exception.
practice_templates.success_check: Explain checked versus unchecked and when finally or try-with-resources runs.
practice_templates.resource_hint: Java tutorial: exceptions

practice_templates.title: Pick the right collection
practice_templates.action: Solve three tasks: deduplicate a list of emails, count word frequency in a paragraph, and keep items in insertion order. Choose HashSet, HashMap and ArrayList/LinkedHashSet and justify each.
practice_templates.success_check: State the average time complexity of get/add/contains for each collection you used.
practice_templates.resource_hint: Java Collections framework overview

practice_templates.title: Generic utility methods
practice_templates.action: Write a generic max(List<T>) bounded by Comparable<T> and a sum(List<? extends Number>) method. Try to add to the wildcard list and read the compiler error.
practice_templates.success_check: Explain extends versus super wildcards (PECS) in your own words.
practice_templates.resource_hint: search: java generics wildcards PECS

practice_templates.title: Sort three ways
practice_templates.action: Sort a List<Person> by name, then by age descending, then by age then name using Comparator.comparing, thenComparing and reversed.
practice_templates.success_check: Write each comparator from memory.
practice_templates.resource_hint: Java docs: Comparator

practice_templates.title: Complexity labelling
practice_templates.action: For 8 small functions (single loop, nested loop, halving loop, recursion), write the Big-O and justify it in one line. Check by timing with doubled input sizes.
practice_templates.success_check: Label four new snippets correctly without running them.
practice_templates.resource_hint: search: big o cheat sheet; analysis of algorithms

practice_templates.title: Two pointers and sliding window
practice_templates.action: Solve: two-sum on a sorted array, reverse a string in place, longest substring without repeats.
practice_templates.success_check: Describe the invariant that makes each solution correct.
practice_templates.resource_hint: search: two pointers technique; sliding window

practice_templates.title: Recursion to memoization
practice_templates.action: Write recursive factorial and Fibonacci, then add memoization to Fibonacci and measure the speed up for n=40.
practice_templates.success_check: Explain the base case, the recursive case and why memoization helps.
practice_templates.resource_hint: search: recursion base case memoization

practice_templates.title: Join practice set
practice_templates.action: On a customers/orders schema write queries with INNER JOIN, LEFT JOIN and one query that finds customers with no orders.
practice_templates.success_check: Explain which rows each join keeps, using a 3-row example.
practice_templates.resource_hint: search: sql joins visualised; SQLBolt

practice_templates.title: Normalise a messy table
practice_templates.action: Take a single orders spreadsheet with repeated customer and product details and split it into 1NF, 2NF and 3NF tables with keys.
practice_templates.success_check: Name the anomaly that each normal form removes.
practice_templates.resource_hint: search: database normalization 1NF 2NF 3NF

practice_templates.title: Index experiment
practice_templates.action: Load 100k rows, time a lookup by email, add an index, time it again, and read the EXPLAIN plan before and after.
practice_templates.success_check: Explain why the index helps and one cost it adds.
practice_templates.resource_hint: search: sql index explain plan

practice_templates.title: NumPy shape drills
practice_templates.action: Create arrays with arange, reshape and zeros. Practise slicing, axis sums (axis=0 vs axis=1) and boolean masks on a 3x4 array.
practice_templates.success_check: Predict the shape and result of 5 operations before running them.
practice_templates.resource_hint: NumPy quickstart

practice_templates.title: Choose the structure
practice_templates.action: Solve small tasks using list, tuple, set and dict (dedupe, counting, lookup by id, immutable record). Say why each structure fits.
practice_templates.success_check: Explain mutability and hashability and why lists cannot be dict keys.
practice_templates.resource_hint: Python docs: data structures

practice_templates.title: Loop versus vectorized
practice_templates.action: Compute the square of 1 million numbers with a Python loop and with NumPy. Time both and try a broadcasting example.
practice_templates.success_check: Explain why the vectorized version is faster and what broadcasting does.
practice_templates.resource_hint: search: numpy vectorization broadcasting

practice_templates.title: Vectors and matrices by hand
practice_templates.action: Compute dot products, a 2x3 times 3x2 matrix product and a transpose by hand, then confirm with NumPy.
practice_templates.success_check: Explain the shape rule for matrix multiplication.
practice_templates.resource_hint: 3Blue1Brown: essence of linear algebra

practice_templates.title: Probability and Bayes practice
practice_templates.action: Compute mean, variance and standard deviation for a small dataset. Work through the rare-disease test example with Bayes' theorem using counts.
practice_templates.success_check: Explain why a positive result on an accurate test can still be probably a false alarm.
practice_templates.resource_hint: search: bayes theorem natural frequencies; khan academy statistics

practice_templates.title: Gradient descent by hand
practice_templates.action: For f(x) = (x-3)^2 take 5 gradient descent steps by hand with learning rate 0.1, then try a rate that is too large.
practice_templates.success_check: Explain what the gradient sign and the learning rate do.
practice_templates.resource_hint: search: gradient descent intuition

practice_templates.title: Select and filter drill
practice_templates.action: Load a CSV and practise column selection, loc versus iloc, boolean filtering and sorting.
practice_templates.success_check: Write the loc and iloc forms for the same selection and say when each is correct.
practice_templates.resource_hint: pandas: 10 minutes to pandas

practice_templates.title: Groupby and merge workout
practice_templates.action: Using sales and customers CSVs, compute average sales per city with groupby and join customer details with merge (inner and left).
practice_templates.success_check: Explain what each merge type does to unmatched rows.
practice_templates.resource_hint: pandas docs: groupby, merge

practice_templates.title: Missing data handling
practice_templates.action: Find missing values with isna().sum(), then try dropna, fill with mean, fill with median and a missing-indicator column. Compare summary statistics.
practice_templates.success_check: Explain a downside of mean imputation and one alternative.
practice_templates.resource_hint: pandas docs: working with missing data
